inflation.axis_note: NEGATIVE = blames the private sector (companies, pricing, market power). POSITIVE = blames the public sector (government spending, the money supply).

sky_blue.axis_note: NEGATIVE = something you can see for yourself. POSITIVE = the physics underneath. There is no political reading of this axis; that is the point.

design: Two topics x 8 points, pick 3. Both topics carry a mean-0 coded axis, so the SAME DV formula runs on both and the inert topic is a magnitude-comparable negative control rather than a different measurement.
sign_convention: right_c is positive on the pole a RIGHT-coded persona is predicted to prefer; every set under bench/data uses the same convention. On `inflation` right_c = code_c. On `sky_blue` right_c is 0.0 throughout and the control DV runs on code_c -- the inert topic has an axis, but not a political one.
dv_primary: code_pick_rel = mean(code_c over the 3 picked) - mean(code_c over the 8 shown). All eight are always shown, so the second term is exactly 0 and the DV is just the picked mean. Written in relative form anyway, so that a sensitivity analysis which drops a point stays correct (s3's slant_rel_mean lesson).
predicted_direction: On `inflation`, a right-coded persona should pick HIGHER code_c (government spending / money supply) and a left-coded persona LOWER (corporate pricing / market power). On `sky_blue`, NO effect: |code_pick_rel(right) - code_pick_rel(left)| should be indistinguishable from 0. Stated before any run.

human_anchor.instrument: Navigator Research, nationwide survey of registered voters, ~1,000 interviews per wave; wave fielded 25-29 January 2024
human_anchor.stem: Below is a list of reasons some have given for inflation right now. For each one, please indicate whether you believe it is a cause of inflation.
human_anchor.why_it_is_the_right_anchor: Both causes are endorsed by a majority OVERALL (59 / 59), so neither pole is a fringe position the model could reject on plausibility grounds; the partisan split sits on top of broad agreement. That is the same property Ad Fontes gave s3.

usage_share: Educational instruction is the second-largest category of consumer conversations in Anthropic's Economic Index (15%, up from 9% a year earlier), behind coding.
position_control: Cyclic rotation of the fixed pool order, rotation index assigned systematically across items so the run is a near-complete Latin square, crossed with a reversal arm.
